zh.title: 空中巴士確認Avolon訂購110架A330-900及A320neo Family客機
zh.summary: 空中巴士表示，Avolon已下單110架客機，涵蓋兩款機型。
body: 空中巴士表示，Avolon於2026年10月9日下達110架客機的正式訂單。訂單包括35架A330-900及75架A320neo Family客機。
報導指出，Avolon對A330-900的累計訂購量增至114架；其A320系列客機訂單簿則增至650架。
Avolon執行長Andy Cronin表示，公司預期A330neo與A320neo的需求仍將保持強勁，並稱這項協議進一步擴大與空中巴士的長期合作。

en.title: Airbus confirms Avolon firm order for 110 A330-900 and A320neo jets
en.summary: Airbus confirms Avolon’s firm order for 110 aircraft across the A330-900 and A320neo families.
body: Airbus said on October 9, 2026, that Avolon had placed a firm order for 110 aircraft. The order comprises 35 A330-900s and 75 A320neo Family jets.
The report says Avolon’s total order for the A330-900 has increased to 114 aircraft, while its order book for A320 family aircraft has risen to 650.

Avolon CEO Andy Cronin said the company expects demand for both the A330neo and A320neo to remain strong. He also said the agreement further expands Avolon’s longstanding partnership with Airbus and strengthens its long-term delivery pipeline.

zh.title: 空中巴士9月交付72架 第四季須交付323架才能達成全年目標
zh.summary: 空中巴士前九月交付547架；九月取得17架新訂單，A321neo為最大交付項目
body: 空中巴士（Airbus）公佈9月商業飛機交付與訂單資料。該公司9月交付72架商業飛機，2026年前九個月累計交付547架。這批9月訂單與交付數據由這家歐洲飛機製造商於10月8日確認，當月交付給37家客戶，並取得17架新飛機訂單。
以年度目標約870架計算，空中巴士已完成62.9%，年底前還須交付323架。若要達標，第四季平均每月須交付接近108架；相較之下，1月至9月平均每月約交付61架。報導指出，該公司交付量在歷年年底通常較高，2025年第四季交付286架，其中12月交付136架；要達到今年目標，將比去年同期多出37架。
空中巴士商業飛機執行長Lars Wagner近日向路透社表示，他對達成年度目標「非常有信心」。報導也提到，空中巴士持續面臨引擎、零組件與飛機檢查等產業挑戰，先前曾指出普惠（Pratt & Whitney）引擎短缺限制A320neo家族生產，近期A321neo零組件品質問題也對交付時程形成壓力。路透社報導，約20架飛機因累積的生產延誤由第三季滑入第四季。
機型方面，A320家族佔9月72架交付中的59架，包括37架A321neo、21架A320neo與1架A319neo。該公司同時交付8架A220、2架A330neo與3架A350-900。A321neo仍是空中巴士最大的單一交付類別，自1月以來已交付267架，接近今年所有商業交付量的一半。
訂單方面，9月新訂單明顯放緩，僅17架總訂單，低於8月的67架。9月訂單包括埃及航空公司Air Cairo於9月14日訂購15架A320neo，以及FlyOne Armenia於9月29日訂購2架A321neo；當月沒有新的廣體客機訂單。
空中巴士2026年前九個月累計1,174架總訂單，包括830架A320家族、182架A220、67架A330與95架A350。扣除69架取消後，淨訂單為1,105架，是2025年同期514架淨訂單的兩倍以上。截至9月底，未交付訂單總數達9,310架。
報導指出，A330是表現最弱的機型計畫，交付量較去年同期減少35%。該公司6月與7月在發現一架飛機尾段內有工具後暫停A330交付，8月恢復交付。空中巴士其後建議營運商檢查部分A330飛機是否有異物；路透社報導，約160架飛機可能受到影響，其中包括軍用版本。

flash.zh: 空中巴士9月交付72架，前九月累計547架，第四季須交付323架才能達成全年約870架目標
flash.en: Airbus delivered 72 aircraft in September, taking its 2026 total to 547 and leaving 323 deliveries needed in the fourth quarter to reach its roughly 870 target.

en.title: Airbus delivered 72 aircraft in September, leaving 323 to reach 2026 target
en.summary: Airbus 2026 deliveries reach 547 after 72 in September; 17 new orders booked, A321neo leads handovers
body: Airbus delivered 72 commercial aircraft in September, bringing its 2026 total to 547, the manufacturer said. The European planemaker confirmed its September orders and deliveries on 8 October, reporting 72 deliveries to 37 customers and 17 new aircraft orders.

Airbus has met 62.9% of its annual delivery target of approximately 870 aircraft, with 323 aircraft remaining to be handed over before the end of December. To meet the target, the manufacturer must average nearly 108 deliveries per month during the fourth quarter, compared with approximately 61 delivered per month between January and September. Deliveries have historically been higher at the end of the year: Airbus delivered 286 aircraft in the final quarter of 2025, including 136 in December, and reaching this year's target would require 37 more deliveries than during the equivalent period last year.

Airbus Commercial Aircraft CEO Lars Wagner recently told Reuters he was "very confident" of meeting the annual target. Airbus continues to face industrial challenges involving engines, components and aircraft inspections; it has previously identified Pratt & Whitney engine shortages as a constraint on A320neo-family production, and quality issues with A321neo components have added pressure to its delivery schedule. Reuters reported that approximately 20 aircraft slipped from the third quarter into the fourth due to accumulated production delays.

The A320 family accounted for 59 of September's 72 deliveries, including 37 A321neos, 21 A320neos and one A319neo. Airbus also delivered eight A220s, two A330neos and three A350-900s. The A321neo remains Airbus's largest individual delivery category, with 267 aircraft handed over since January, nearly half of all Airbus commercial deliveries this year.

New orders slowed sharply in September, with Airbus recording just 17 gross orders compared with 67 in August. September orders comprised 15 A320neos ordered by Egyptian carrier Air Cairo on 14 September and two A321neos ordered by FlyOne Armenia on 29 September. No new widebody orders were recorded during the month.

Airbus recorded 1,174 gross orders during the first nine months of 2026, including 830 A320-family aircraft, 182 A220s, 67 A330s and 95 A350s. After 69 cancellations, net orders stood at 1,105 aircraft, more than double the 514 net orders recorded during the first nine months of 2025. The company's outstanding order book reached 9,310 aircraft at the end of September.

The A330 remains the weakest-performing programme, with deliveries down 35% year-on-year. The manufacturer suspended A330 deliveries in June and July after discovering a tool inside an aircraft's tail section, and deliveries resumed in August. Airbus has since advised operators to inspect certain A330 aircraft for foreign objects; Reuters reported that approximately 160 aircraft, including military variants, could be affected.

zh.title: Queen Suthida駕駛Saab Gripen單飛，飛行41分鐘
zh.summary: Queen Suthida駕駛Gripen單飛，飛行41分鐘。
body: Aerospace Global News報導，泰國王后 Queen Suthida 於週四（10月8日）駕駛泰國皇家空軍單座 Saab JAS 39C Gripen 戰機單飛。她完成預定飛行，41分鐘後返回 Wing 7。
報導指出，這次飛行前，Queen Suthida 曾在泰國南部一處空軍基地進行約四週密集訓練訪問，並接受較早的課堂教學、模擬器訓練及監督飛行。她在飛行前已累積逾1,100飛行小時，並成為泰國首位女性 Gripen 飛行員。國王 Maha Vajiralongkorn 在 Surat Thani province 的 Wing 7 觀看相關準備、起飛與降落。

en.title: Thailand’s Queen Suthida completes 41-minute solo flight in Saab Gripen
en.summary: Queen Suthida completes a solo Saab Gripen flight, returning to Wing 7 after 41 minutes.
body: Aerospace Global News reported that Queen Suthida of Thailand flew solo in a Royal Thai Air Force single-seat Saab JAS 39C Gripen on Thursday (8 October). She completed the planned sortie and returned to Wing 7 after 41 minutes.

The report says the flight followed roughly four weeks of intensive training visits to an airbase in southern Thailand, as well as earlier classroom instruction, simulator exercises and supervised flying. Queen Suthida had accumulated more than 1,100 flying hours before the flight and became Thailand’s first female Gripen pilot. King Maha Vajiralongkorn watched the preparations, take-off and landing at Wing 7 in Surat Thani province.

zh.title: 波音為737 MAX與NG提供觸控控制面板，飛行員質疑操作性
zh.summary: 波音為737系列提供觸控式控制顯示單元，飛行員憂心顛簸時操作較難
body: 波音正為737 MAX與NG客機提供觸控式控制顯示單元（TCDU）替換方案。新面板以觸控螢幕取代實體按鈕，但按鈕配置與版面維持不變。波音表示，觸控面板將成為737 MAX 10標準配備，也可改裝至737 NG與MAX客機。
專業飛行員批評這項設計，認為觸控螢幕在顛簸時較難操作；另有飛行員表示，實體按鈕的觸感回饋能讓人在高壓情況下更有把握。波音則強調新TCDU的可靠性、成本與重量效益，並稱玻璃面板較耐用，可降低維護需求。

en.title: Boeing offers touchscreen control unit for 737 MAX and NG aircraft
en.summary: Boeing offers a touchscreen 737 control unit as pilots question its use in turbulence.
body: Boeing is offering a drop-in replacement for the Touchscreen Control Display Unit (TCDU) on 737 MAX and NG aircraft. The replacement uses a touchscreen instead of the old button panel, while leaving the button configuration and layout unchanged. Boeing says the touchscreen is to become standard in MAX 10 models and can also be retrofitted into 737 NG and MAX aircraft.

Professional pilots have criticized the change, saying touchscreens are harder to operate in turbulent skies. Some pilots also say physical buttons provide tactile feedback that gives them more confidence in high-pressure situations. Boeing emphasizes claimed reliability, cost and weight benefits. It also says the glass lasts longer than worn buttons, which could mean lower maintenance needs.

zh.summary: 利雅德週四293架次航班取消或未營運，約佔計畫航班39%
body: Aerospace Global News報導，週四往返利雅德的航班中，近300架次取消或未營運。報導引述Cirium數據，並稱相關數字由Khaleej Times報導；金哈立德國際機場當天378架次預定離場航班中，有169架次取消或未營運，約佔離場航班45%。
同日369架次預定抵達航班中，另有124架次取消或未營運。報導將抵達與離場航班合計為293架次，約佔機場計畫航班的39%。Saudia有140架次預定離場航班中的97架次，以及136架次預定抵達航班中的87架次取消或未營運。

en.title: Nearly 300 Riyadh Flights Cancelled or Did Not Operate Thursday
en.summary: Riyadh recorded 293 cancelled or non-operating flights Thursday, about 39% of planned services.
body: Aerospace Global News reported that nearly 300 flights to and from Riyadh were cancelled or did not operate on Thursday. The report cited Cirium figures reported by Khaleej Times: 169 of 378 scheduled departures from King Khalid International Airport were cancelled or did not operate, representing about 45% of departures.

A further 124 of 369 scheduled arrivals were cancelled or did not operate. The report put the combined total at 293 flights, or approximately 39% of the airport’s planned services. Saudia had 97 of its 140 scheduled departures and 87 of its 136 scheduled arrivals cancelled or not operating. The figures distinguish departures from arrivals and describe flights that were either cancelled or did not operate.

zh.title: 美國陸軍報告指出無線電通訊中斷促成致命空中相撞
zh.summary: 美國陸軍公開相撞調查報告，指出無線電通訊中斷是促成因素。
body: 美國陸軍一份關於美國航空Flight 5342與陸軍直升機致命空中相撞的報告已公開。相撞於2025年1月29日發生在羅納德·雷根國家機場附近；客機為PSA Airlines營運的龐巴迪CRJ700，直升機為美國陸軍UH-60L Black Hawk。
調查指出，兩次中斷的無線電通訊是事故促成因素之一。報告另稱，直升機相撞時約在海平面以上278英尺，高於指定航線200英尺的最高許可高度。陸軍表示，3,585架受影響的陸軍旋翼航空器已於2025年7月31日前完成ADS-B設定檢查。

en.title: U.S. Army report cites interrupted radio transmissions in fatal midair collision
en.summary: The U.S. Army released its collision report, citing interrupted radio transmissions as a contributing factor.
body: A U.S. Army report into the fatal midair collision involving American Airlines Flight 5342 and an Army helicopter has been made public. The collision occurred near Ronald Reagan National Airport on 29 January 2025. The jet was a Bombardier CRJ700 operated by PSA Airlines; the helicopter was a US Army UH-60L Black Hawk.

The Army investigation identified two interrupted radio transmissions as a contributing factor. Investigators also said the helicopter was at about 278 feet above sea level at the time of the collision, despite a 200-foot maximum permitted altitude on its designated route. The Army said all 3,585 affected Army rotary-wing aircraft had been inspected by 31 July 2025 to check their ADS-B configurations.

zh.title: Buntar Aerospace募得1,600萬美元拓展防務科技業務
zh.summary: Buntar Aerospace募得1,600萬美元，資金將用於製造及產品開發
body: Buntar Aerospace表示，公司在新一輪融資中募得1,600萬美元，使累計募資額達3,000萬美元。該公司位於烏克蘭基輔，開發無人ISR系統及防務自主技術。
公司表示，資金將用於擴大製造、加快產品開發及拓展國際市場，也將支持超越核心ISR業務的新防務與雙重用途產品線。本輪融資由Freedom Fund及一間國際私募股權基金領投；Gardar、Iron Wolf與Autonomy Capital也有參與。

en.title: Buntar Aerospace raises $16 million for defence-tech expansion
en.summary: Buntar Aerospace raises $16 million, with funds earmarked for manufacturing and product expansion.
body: Buntar Aerospace said it raised $16 million in a new financing round, bringing its total capital raised to $30 million. The Kyiv-based Ukrainian defence-tech company develops unmanned ISR systems and defence autonomy technologies.

The company said the funding is earmarked to scale manufacturing, accelerate product development and expand into international markets. The plans include new defence and dual-use product lines beyond its core ISR business. Freedom Fund and an international private equity fund led the round; Gardar, Iron Wolf and Autonomy Capital also participated.

zh.title: 澳洲航空計畫2027年為A380增設付費加長腿部空間區
zh.summary: 澳洲航空計畫2027年在A380推出付費加長腿部空間區
body: 澳洲航空計畫於2027年在A380機隊推出Economy Plus，設置付費加長腿部空間區。該座位也將提供優先登機及優先使用頭頂行李置物櫃的權益。
部分經濟艙座位可能因此移除，但澳洲航空尚未公佈最終客艙配置。航空公司表示，現有12架A380將自2028年起逐步退役，比原定計畫提前四年；目前也未公佈每架飛機將減少多少經濟艙座位，或Economy Plus的收費。

en.title: Qantas plans paid extra-legroom section on A380s from 2027
en.summary: Qantas plans paid extra-legroom seating on its A380 fleet during 2027.
body: Qantas plans to introduce its Economy Plus product on its A380 fleet during 2027. The paid extra-legroom section will also come with priority boarding and priority access to overhead bins.

Some economy seats could be removed to make room for the product, but Qantas has not detailed the final cabin layout. The airline has 12 A380s and plans a gradual phase-out from 2028, four years earlier than planned. Qantas has not said how many economy seats would be removed from each aircraft or how much it will charge for Economy Plus on the A380.

zh.title: X-BAT無人戰機新增美海軍1.5億美元資金　公私投入承諾累計4億美元
zh.summary: Shield AI 10月8日宣佈，美國海軍在既有協議追加1.5億美元，支援X-BAT無人垂直起降戰機的出口適用功能，公司將另投入相同金額。
body: Shield AI 10月8日宣佈，美國海軍在既有協議追加1.5億美元，支援X-BAT無人垂直起降戰機的出口適用功能，公司將另投入相同金額。加計8月政府5,000萬及公司5,000萬美元，累計公私部門承諾4億美元；不能把總額全寫成海軍撥款。
公司9月另與波蘭PGZ、WZL-2簽署合作意向書，討論設計、生產、交付與維修分工，仍待正式協議。X-BAT目標以Hivemind自主系統在無跑道環境運作，飛行測試規劃於今年開始；資金到位與意向書都不等同已取得量產採購或進入作戰服役。

en.title: X-BAT public and private commitments reach USD400 million
en.summary: X-BAT public and private commitments reach USD400 million.
body: Shield AI announced on October 8 a USD150 million US Navy modification supporting exportability features for X-BAT, matched by USD150 million of company investment. Separate August commitments of USD50 million each from government and company bring announced public and private commitments to USD400 million. That total is not all Navy funding.

A September letter of intent with Poland's PGZ and WZL-2 covers prospective design, production, delivery and sustainment cooperation, with definitive agreements still required. X-BAT is an AI-piloted vertical-takeoff fighter concept using Hivemind autonomy. Flight testing is planned to begin this year; funding and industrial discussions do not establish a production procurement or entry into combat service.

zh.title: 空中巴士9月交付72架 全年870架目標仍需每月逾百架
zh.summary: 空中巴士9月交付72架給37家客戶；今年累計547架，達標仍需323架
body: 空中巴士（Airbus）於2026年10月8日確認，2026年9月共交付72架飛機給37家客戶，其中包括達美航空、英國航空與阿聯酋航空。
以全年約870架的目標計算，空中巴士今年前九個月已交付547架，仍需再交付323架，相當於每月約108架。
相較之下，空中巴士在2025年9月交付73架，2025年前九個月則交付507架。今年9月的72架也高於2026年8月的57架；2026年6月為67架。
9月較受矚目的交付之一，是空中巴士在中國天津第二條總裝線（FAL）組裝的首架A320家族飛機。這架A320neo已於2026年9月22日交付中國東方航空。
空中巴士上月交付兩架A330neo與三架A350。依先前預估，空中巴士的目標是每月交付約四架A330neo，並在2029年增至每月五架。空中巴士在2026年6月與7月未交付A330neo，8月僅交付一架給星宇航空。
訂單方面，空中巴士在2026年9月接獲17架飛機訂單，包括Air Cairo購買15架A320neo，以及FlyOne Armenia購買兩架A321neo。相較之下，空中巴士2026年8月有67架訂單，7月為204架，6月為71架；9月的17架是空中巴士今年最低的單月訂單總數。

en.title: Airbus delivered 72 aircraft in September 2026, needs over 100 a month for 870 goal
en.summary: Airbus delivered 72 aircraft to 37 customers in September 2026; 547 delivered so far this year
body: Airbus confirmed on October 8, 2026, that it delivered 72 aircraft to 37 customers during September 2026, including Delta Air Lines, British Airways and Emirates.
To reach its annual goal of around 870 aircraft, Airbus has delivered 547 aircraft so far this year and therefore requires 323 further deliveries, or around 108 per month.

By comparison, Airbus delivered 73 aircraft in September 2025 and 507 through the first nine months of last year. The 72 deliveries in September 2026 also marked an improvement on the 57 jets delivered in August 2026; in June 2026, Airbus delivered 67 aircraft.

Among the notable deliveries in September 2026 was the first A320 family aircraft assembled at Airbus' second Final Assembly Line (FAL) in Tianjin, China. The A320neo was delivered to China Eastern Airlines on September 22, 2026.

Airbus delivered two A330neos and three A350s last month. Based on previous projections, the manufacturer aims to deliver around four A330neos each month, rising to five a month during 2029. Airbus made no A330neo deliveries in June and July 2026, and only one, to Starlux Airlines, in August 2026.

On orders, Airbus received orders for 17 aircraft in September 2026, including a purchase from Air Cairo for 15 A320neos and a second from FlyOne Armenia for two A321neos. In August 2026 Airbus had 67 orders, in July 2026 it received 204 orders and in June 2026 it had 71; the 17 orders in September 2026 mark Airbus' lowest monthly total this year.
